mapper.sql: id, candidate_id, file_name, file_path, file_type, size_bytes, parse_status, parsed_data, content_text, parse_message, parsed_at, uploaded_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cvs (candidate_id, file_name, file_path, file_type, size_bytes, parse_status, parsed_data, content_text, parse_message, parsed_at, uploaded_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{candidateId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{parseStatus}, CAST(#{parsedData} AS JSONB), #{contentText}, #{parseMessage}, #{parsedAt}, #{uploadedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE cvs SET parse_status = #{parseStatus}, parsed_data = CAST(#{parsedData} AS JSONB), content_text = #{contentText}, parse_message = #{parseMessage}, parsed_at = #{parsedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cvs WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = FALSE
SELECT FROM cvs WHERE candidate_id = #{candidateId} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC, id DESC
